design.notes: Part3 native repair of source ID 33. Vành đu quay là vòng lớn, trục là vòng nhỏ, 8 nan hoa là thanh hướng tâm, 8 cabin là vòng treo ngoài vành, chân đế là thanh. Removed unproven picture-only Bomb and drawing arms; no Booster/Chain. Native .5-unit tube, pins and complete Guides only. Drawing tabs replaced by real engaged joints. Wheel 7.5-unit radius uses uniform22px/unit; all cabins at exact native spacing, openings moved onto material-safe directions. Two top cabins own inward pins away from wheel gap. One short tangential hub strut replaces a radial shaft that disagreed with native passage; seven radial spokes remain. Figure silhouette is a design reference, not evidence of difficulty or necessary cross-object preparation for every bar. No campaign import. Validation/full-gesture evidence: research/20261015-genai-part3-v03.
